title: Google loses court fight against $854,250 Italian fine over gambling advertising
title_zh: 谷歌在意大利因赌博广告被罚款 854,255 美元的诉讼中败诉
summary: Alphabet unit Google on Thursday lost its fight against a €750,000 ($854,250) fine imposed for gambling ‌advertising on its YouTube video platform four years ago as ‌Europe's top court sided with Italy's communication authority.
summary_zh: 四年前，Alphabet 子公司谷歌因在其 YouTube 视频平台上投放赌博广告而被处以 750,000 欧元（合 854,250 美元）罚款，周四，由于欧洲最高法院支持意大利通信当局，谷歌在这场官司中败诉。
